neighbours.label: the boundary noun that something happens before or below: 'end' after 'before the', 'fin' after 'avant la', 'sunset', 'horizon', as against the same noun after 'at the' and other times of day
fire: The contractors promised to finish the roof before the end of August.
We watched the last sliver of the moon slip below the horizon.
Le gouvernement présentera le projet avant la fin du mois.
Hikers were told to be back at the hut shortly before sunset.
Most of the votes should be counted before the end of the night.
The ship's lights vanished beneath the horizon around midnight.
Les travaux doivent être terminés avant la fin de l'été.
The farmers hurried to bring in the hay just before sunset.
quiet: The contractors finally finished the roof at the end of August.
We watched the last sliver of the moon light up the bay.
Le gouvernement a présenté le projet au début du mois.
Hikers were told to be back at the hut shortly after lunch.
Most of the votes were counted at the end of the night.
The ship's lights vanished into the fog around midnight.
Les travaux ont commencé au début de l'été.
The farmers hurried to bring in the hay on Tuesday morning.
